items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won LIV Golf Korea in a playoff over Talor Gooch, earning his eighth LIV title and stabilizing the league amid funding uncertainty.

items.headline: Potgieter Breaks NCAA Record
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended a bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, surpassing the previous 74-hole record.
